repos.description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持在 WhatsApp、Telegram、Slack 等主流通讯平台运行，兼容 macOS/iOS/Android 系统，具备语音交互与实时画布渲染能力。其网关为控制平面，核心产品是本地部署的个性化助手，强调隐私、速度与持续在线体验。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on your own devices across any OS and platform. It integrates with messaging apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack, supports voice interaction, live canvas rendering, and prioritizes local deployment for privacy, speed, and always-on personal assistance.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: ECC 是一个面向 AI 智能体的高性能操作框架，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等主流 AI 编程工具设计。它提供技能管理、本能响应、记忆优化、安全扫描与研究优先的开发模式，支持跨工具统一架构，已在真实产品中经过 10 个月高强度验证。
repos.summary_en: ECC is a high-performance operator system for AI agents, built for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more. It offers skills, instincts, memory optimization, security scanning, and research-first development, with a cross-harness architecture validated through 10+ months of real-world production use.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: Everything Claude Code 是一个专为 AI 智能体性能优化设计的完整系统，涵盖技能、直觉、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cowork 等平台，提供生产级代理、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置，适用于多语言环境，是 Anthropic 黑客马拉松获奖作品。
repos.summary_en: Everything Claude Code is a comprehensive performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, featuring skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, and more, offering production-ready agents, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configurations, evolved over 10+ months of real-world use.

repos.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
repos.summary_zh: 一个包含多种专业AI智能体（如前端开发、社区运营、创意注入等）的集合，每个智能体都具备独特的人格、工作流程和交付标准。支持一键安装到Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot等多种主流AI编程工具中，旨在为开发者提供全天候、高专业度的虚拟专家团队。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive collection of specialized AI agents (e.g., frontend wizards, community ninjas) featuring distinct personalities, workflows, and deliverables. It supports one-click installation into various AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, providing developers with a 24/7 virtual expert team.

repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 构建的现代化 Clash.Meta 客户端，支持跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），提供简洁美观的 GUI 界面、配置文件管理、TUN 模式、WebDav 同步及自定义主题，适用于高性能代理需求。
repos.summary_en: Clash Verge Rev is a modern GUI client for Clash.Meta (mihomo) built with Tauri 2 and Rust, offering cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux), intuitive UI, config management, TUN mode, WebDav sync, and customizable themes for advanced proxy control.

repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面一体化助手工具，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的统一管理，提供便捷的 AI 编程助手集成与配置，适用于多模型协作开发场景。
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform desktop all-in-one assistant tool for managing Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, enabling unified configuration and integration of multiple AI coding assistants for streamlined development workflows.

repos.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max 是一款 AI 技能，专为多平台构建专业 UI/UX 设计而生。其核心功能是通过 AI 驱动的设计系统生成器，快速分析项目需求并输出适配不同框架的完整设计体系，支持 67 种 UI 风格与 100 条推理规则，显著提升跨平台设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max is an AI skill delivering intelligent design solutions for professional UI/UX across multiple platforms. Its flagship Design System Generator uses AI reasoning to instantly analyze project requirements and generate tailored, framework-agnostic design systems, supporting 67 UI styles and 100 reasoning rules for efficient cross-platform design.

repos.description: :books: 免费的计算机编程类中文书籍，欢迎投稿
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是免费的中文编程书籍索引库，涵盖操作系统、Web开发、算法、大数据等语言无关和语言相关的计算机技术书籍，提供高质量的学习资源集合，支持社区投稿与更新，助力程序员技能提升。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a curated collection of free Chinese programming books covering computer science fundamentals, web development, algorithms, and major programming languages, serving as a valuable learning resource for developers with community-driven contributions.

repos.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others
repos.summary_zh: v2rayN 是一款基于 .NET 的跨平台 GUI 代理客户端，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 系统。它集成了 Xray、sing-box 等多种核心，提供简洁易用的界面来管理复杂的网络代理配置，并支持 GPG 签名校验以确保软件分发安全。
repos.summary_en: v2rayN is a cross-platform GUI proxy client built on .NET, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It integrates multiple cores like Xray and sing-box, offering a user-friendly interface to manage complex network proxy configurations, with GPG signature verification for secure software distribution.

repos.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
repos.summary_zh: OpenCut 是一款免费开源的视频编辑器，支持网页、桌面和移动端，提供时间轴编辑、多轨道支持、实时预览等功能，无水印且无需订阅。注重隐私保护，所有视频处理在本地完成，核心功能对标 CapCut，适合追求简洁高效的用户。
repos.summary_en: OpenCut is a free, open-source video editor for web, desktop, and mobile, offering timeline-based editing, multi-track support, and real-time preview. It emphasizes privacy by processing videos locally, avoids watermarks, and targets users seeking CapCut-like simplicity without paywalled features.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: An awesome list that curates the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, articles and more.
repos.summary_zh: Solido/awesome-flutter 是一个精选的 Flutter 资源库，涵盖最佳库、工具、教程、文章等，为开发者提供全面的 Flutter 开发指南，助力跨平台应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Solido/awesome-flutter is a curated list of the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, and articles, serving as a comprehensive resource for Flutter developers to build cross-platform applications.

repos.description: :atom: The hackable text editor
repos.summary_zh: Atom 是一款基于 Electron 构建的现代化可定制文本编辑器，专为 21 世纪开发者设计。它融合了经典编辑器的优点，支持深度自定义但默认配置友好易用，适用于跨平台开发环境。
repos.summary_en: Atom is a hackable, modern text editor built on Electron, designed for deep customization while remaining approachable. It combines the best features of traditional editors with a flexible, open-source architecture for developers.

repos.description: ☄🌌️  The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt for any shell!
repos.summary_zh: Starship 是一款极简、极速且高度可定制的跨平台命令行提示符工具，支持任意 Shell（如 Bash、Zsh、Fish、PowerShell 等）。它通过 Rust 编写，性能卓越，能智能显示 Git 状态、编程语言版本、环境变量等上下文信息，极大提升终端使用效率与视觉体验。
repos.summary_en: Starship is a minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable cross-shell prompt written in Rust. It intelligently displays contextual information like Git status, language versions, and environment variables across any shell (Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, etc.), enhancing terminal productivity and aesthetics.

repos.description: A multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta,simple and easy to use, open-source and ad-free.
repos.summary_zh: FlClash 是一款基于 ClashMeta 的多平台代理客户端，支持 Android、Windows、macOS 和 Linux，具备 Material You 设计、深色模式、WebDAV 数据同步及订阅链接管理功能，界面简洁无广告，适用于需要跨平台网络代理的用户。
repos.summary_en: FlClash is a multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta, supporting Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features Material You design, dark mode, WebDAV sync, subscription management, and an ad-free, open-source interface for seamless cross-device proxy control.

repos.description: the runtime your coding agents live on
repos.summary_zh: Herdr 是一个基于 Rust 构建的终端 AI 智能体运行时，支持多任务并行、会话持久化及跨设备重新连接。它提供原生终端视图与 Socket API，允许智能体间协作，并通过插件扩展工作流，专为开发者打造高效自动化环境。
repos.summary_en: Herdr is a Rust-based terminal runtime for AI agents, supporting multi-tasking, session persistence, and reattachment across devices. It offers native terminal views and a Socket API for agent collaboration, extensible via plugins, designed to build efficient automation environments for developers.

repos.description: Open-source Rust agent engine and terminal client for Codewhale, with provider choice, tools, approvals and receipts.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale是开源终端编程智能体，用Rust构建，支持任意AI模型。它能读取项目、编辑文件、运行命令并验证结果，适用于自动化代码修复、测试调试与本地开发工作流，提供TUI交互与headless模式。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source coding agent for the terminal, built in Rust and compatible with any AI model. It reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and verifies its own work, suitable for automated code fixes, test debugging, and local development workflows, with TUI and headless modes.

repos.description: Delegate anything. It comes back done.
repos.summary_zh: Minds 是一款面向知识工作者的通用 AI 平台，支持在云、VPC、本地及隔离环境中灵活部署，让用户完全掌控基础设施、模型、权限与数据。它帮助创作者、策略师和运营人员自动化复杂的多步骤读写任务，并无需工程背景即可构建和部署内部 AI 工具（如应用、报告、分析等），实现真正可控的 AI 协作体验。
repos.summary_en: Minds is a general-purpose AI platform designed for knowledge workers—creators, strategists, and operators—offering full control over AI systems with flexible deployment across cloud, VPC, on-prem, and air-gapped environments. It enables users to automate complex multi-step read/write tasks and build, deploy internal AI tools (apps, reports, analyses) without engineering expertise, ensuring complete infrastructure, model, permission, and data control.

repos.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
repos.summary_zh: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: Handy 是一款免费开源的离线语音转文字桌面应用，基于 Whisper 和 Parakeet 模型实现本地语音识别，支持全局快捷键录音、VAD 降噪及多平台运行，注重隐私保护且高度可扩展。
repos.summary_en: Handy is a free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app powered by Whisper and Parakeet models. It offers local transcription with VAD, global hotkeys, and cross-platform support, prioritizing privacy and extensibility.

repos.description: Multi-platform auto-proxy client, supporting Sing-box, X-ray, TUIC, Hysteria, Reality, Trojan, SSH etc. It’s an open-source, secure and ad-free.
repos.summary_zh: Hiddify 是一款跨平台代理客户端，基于 Sing-box 构建，支持 Vless、Vmess、Reality、TUIC、Hysteria、WireGuard、SSH 等多种协议。具备自动节点选择、TUN 模式、远程配置同步等功能，界面简洁、无广告、开源安全，支持多语言及深色/浅色主题，适用于 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: Hiddify is a multi-platform proxy client built on Sing-box, supporting Vless, Vmess, Reality, TUIC, Hysteria, WireGuard, SSH, and more. It features automatic node selection, TUN mode, remote configuration sync, and an intuitive UI. Open-source, ad-free, and secure, it's available on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
repos.summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源的跨平台屏幕录制与编辑工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它无需后期剪辑即可生成专业级演示视频，内置自动缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头气泡叠加、时间轴编辑及扩展市场等功能，专为教程、产品演示等场景优化，显著提升录制效率与视觉表现。
repos.summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It enables polished screen recordings without post-editing by offering auto-zooms, cursor enhancements, dynamic webcam overlays, timeline editing, and a community extension marketplace—ideal for demos, walkthroughs, and product videos.

repos.description: Share a single keyboard and mouse between multiple computers.
repos.summary_zh: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键鼠共享应用，让用户通过一套键盘和鼠标无缝控制多台相邻计算机，实现类似软件 KVM 的体验（无需视频切换）。默认启用 TLS 加密保障安全，支持 Wayland 显示协议及剪贴板共享，跨平台兼容 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，适合多机办公与开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Deskflow is a free and open-source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you seamlessly control nearby computers using one keyboard, mouse, or trackpad — like a software KVM without video switching. TLS encryption is enabled by default, with Wayland support and clipboard sharing. Cross-platform across Windows, macOS, and Linux, ideal for multi-machine workflows.

repos.description: A cross-platform launcher that simply works
repos.summary_zh: Wox 是一款跨平台启动器，提供快速搜索应用、文件、文件夹及AI聊天功能，支持MCP集成。通过插件系统和主题扩展，用户可用JavaScript或Python开发自定义功能。软件为单文件免安装，兼容Windows/macOS/Linux，快捷键操作高效便捷，是Alfred和Raycast的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Wox is a cross-platform launcher offering fast search for apps, files, and folders, plus AI chat with MCP support. It features a plugin system (JavaScript/Python) and themes, runs as a single executable without installation, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. Designed as an open-source alternative to Alfred and Raycast, it emphasizes simplicity and extensibility.

repos.description: 插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
repos.summary_zh: MusicFree 是一款开源、无广告、插件化的免费音乐播放器，专为 Android 和 Harmony OS 设计。其核心特性包括完全本地化数据存储、支持自定义主题与歌词关联功能。通过插件架构，用户可接入第三方音源（如音乐搜索、歌单导入、歌词获取），实现高度定制化体验。项目基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源，强调隐私保护与合法合规使用。
repos.summary_en: MusicFree is an open-source, ad-free, plugin-based music player for Android and Harmony OS. It features local data storage, customizable themes, and lyric linking. Its plugin architecture enables integration with third-party audio sources for search, playback, and playlist import. Built on AGPL 3.0, it prioritizes privacy and ethical use without VIP or cracked content.

repos.description: Bring macOS “Quick Look” feature to Windows
repos.summary_zh: QuickLook 是一款为 Windows 系统移植的 macOS ‘快速查看’ 功能工具，支持通过空格键即时预览文件内容，涵盖图片、文档、视频等多种格式。其核心优势在于轻量化设计、低资源占用和高度可扩展性，用户可通过插件系统自定义预览功能，极大提升文件浏览效率。
repos.summary_en: QuickLook brings macOS 'Quick Look' functionality to Windows, enabling instant file previews by pressing the spacebar. It supports diverse file types including images, documents, and videos with minimal resource usage and extensibility via plugins, significantly enhancing file browsing efficiency.

repos.description: http下载工具，基于http代理，支持多连接分块下载
repos.summary_zh: Proxyee Down 是一款基于 HTTP 代理和 Netty 的高性能开源下载工具，支持多线程分块下载，具备扩展功能以满足特殊需求。项目因 Java 客户端开发限制暂停维护，作者计划用 Go + Flutter 重写以打造跨平台、低内存占用的下一代下载器。
repos.summary_en: Proxyee Down is an open-source, high-speed HTTP downloader built on HTTP proxy and Netty, supporting multi-threaded chunked downloads and extensible plugins. The project is paused due to Java client limitations, with plans to rewrite using Go + Flutter for cross-platform, low-memory usage.

repos.description: Happy is the open-source desktop app for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, with an iOS and Android app to control your coding agents from anywhere.
repos.summary_zh: Happy Coder 是一款移动端和网页端客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex，具备端到端加密、实时语音交互及全功能远程控制。用户可通过手机或网页随时监控 AI 编码进度，实现设备间无缝切换，保障代码安全。
repos.summary_en: Happy Coder is a mobile and web client for Claude Code and Codex, featuring end-to-end encryption, real-time voice, and full-featured remote control. It enables users to monitor AI coding progress from any device, switch sessions instantly, and ensures code privacy with zero telemetry.

repos.description: 🐱 BongoCat — A cross-platform interactive desktop pet that brings fun to your desktop!
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat 是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，基于 Tauri 框架开发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。它以可爱的猫咪形象提供桌面陪伴功能，用户可通过点击、拖拽等交互触发趣味动画，为日常办公增添轻松娱乐元素。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a playful cat character that responds to user interactions like clicks and drags with animated effects, adding entertainment to your desktop experience.

repos.description: flutter 开发者帮助 APP，包含 flutter 常用 140+ 组件的demo 演示与中文文档
repos.summary_zh: FlutterGo 是阿里巴巴推出的 Flutter 开发者辅助应用，提供 140+ 组件的中文文档与演示，帮助开发者快速掌握 Flutter 开发。因团队调整暂停维护，但计划未来迭代并招募社区贡献者。
repos.summary_en: FlutterGo is an Alibaba-developed Flutter developer helper app featuring 140+ component demos and Chinese documentation. It aids developers in mastering Flutter. Due to internal restructuring, maintenance is temporarily paused, with plans for future updates and community contributions.

repos.description: Conversational RPA SDK for Chatbot Makers. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7q8NBZbQzt
repos.summary_zh: Wechaty 是一个对话式 RPA SDK，专为聊天机器人开发者设计，提供跨 WhatsApp、微信等主流消息平台的统一接口，支持 TypeScript、Python、Go 等多语言开发，实现一次编写多平台运行，显著降低聊天机器人开发复杂度。
repos.summary_en: Wechaty is a conversational RPA SDK that simplifies chatbot development by offering a universal interface across messaging platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It supports multiple languages including TypeScript and Python, enabling developers to write once and deploy anywhere, streamlining bot creation with open-source ease and community support.

repos.description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: OpenLogi 是一款用 Rust 编写的本地优先、原生替代 Logitech Options+ 的工具，无需账户或遥测，通过 HID++ 协议直接控制罗技鼠标的按键映射、DPI 和 SmartShift。支持 macOS，提供 GUI 和 CLI 双模式，配置为纯 TOML 文件，强调隐私与离线使用。
repos.summary_en: OpenLogi is a native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry. Supports macOS with GUI and CLI, plain TOML config, privacy-focused and offline-first.

repos.description: 🐱 🧸跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，支持Windows、macOS和Linux。猫咪会在桌面上自由行走、互动，为桌面增添趣味与陪伴感。项目正从Tauri迁移至C/C++、SDL3和OpenGL的原生实现，轻量高效，适合个性化桌面装饰与解压场景。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet app supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. The cat wanders and interacts on your desktop, adding fun and companionship. Migrating from Tauri to a native C/C++ + SDL3 + OpenGL implementation for better performance, ideal for desktop personalization and stress relief.

repos.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
repos.summary_zh: 一个包含1324种健身动作的结构化多语言数据集，涵盖类别、目标肌群、器械、多语言指令及媒体ID。提供开发者向导，便于快速搭建健身应用后端、数据库及API。数据源自ExerciseDB，支持6种语言，适合健身应用开发、AI推荐及健康研究。
repos.summary_en: A structured multilingual dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises with categories, target muscles, equipment, step-by-step instructions in 6 languages, and media IDs. Includes a developer setup wizard for rapid backend, database, and API scaffolding. Ideal for fitness app development, AI recommendations, and health research.

repos.description: An open-source, AI-integrated, cross-platform terminal for seamless workflows
repos.summary_zh: Wave Terminal 是一款开源、集成 AI 的智能跨平台终端，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它兼容任意 AI 模型（如 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），支持本地运行 Ollama 等模型，无需账户即可使用。核心特性包括：持久化 SSH 会话、内嵌远程文件编辑器、富文本预览（Markdown/图片/PDF）、AI 助手实时分析终端输出并操作文件，以及强大的 `wsh` CLI 工具实现工作区管理与跨会话数据同步。
repos.summary_en: Wave Terminal is an open-source, AI-integrated terminal for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It supports any AI model via BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or local models like Ollama/LM Studio. Key features include durable SSH sessions with auto-reconnect, built-in remote file editor, rich file previews (markdown, images, PDFs), context-aware Wave AI assistant that analyzes terminal output and performs file operations, and a powerful `wsh` CLI system for workspace management and cross-session data sync.

repos.description: agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: herdr 是一款运行在终端中的智能体多路复用器，支持工作区、标签页和窗格管理，提供鼠标交互、拖拽分割、实时状态查看（阻塞/工作中/完成）等功能。无需 GUI 应用，直接显示智能体原生终端输出，支持断开后重连且智能体持续运行。适用于 Linux 和 macOS 系统，可通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装。
repos.summary_en: herdr is a terminal-based agent multiplexer that supports workspaces, tabs, and panes with mouse-native interactions like click, drag, and split. It displays real-time agent states (blocked, working, done) and shows the agent's native terminal output. Agents keep running after detach and can be reattached later. No GUI or Electron wrapper—works on Linux and macOS, installable via Homebrew or script.

repos.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
repos.summary_zh: LinkSwift 是一款基于 JavaScript 的网盘直链提取工具，支持百度网盘、阿里云盘、中国移动云盘、天翼云盘、迅雷云盘、夸克网盘、UC网盘及123云盘八大平台。用户通过浏览器脚本即可快速获取文件真实下载地址，跳过官方客户端的限速与繁琐操作，大幅提升跨平台网盘文件下载效率。
repos.summary_en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based tool for extracting direct download links from major Chinese cloud drives, including Baidu Pan, Aliyun Drive, China Mobile Cloud, Tianyi Cloud, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123Pan. It enables users to bypass official client restrictions and obtain real file download URLs directly in the browser, significantly improving cross-platform download efficiency.

repos.description: Lightweight, Portable, Flexible Distributed/Mobile Deep Learning with Dynamic, Mutation-aware Dataflow Dep Scheduler; for Python, R, Julia, Scala, Go, Javascript and more
repos.summary_zh: Apache MXNet 是一个高效灵活的深度学习框架，支持符号式与命令式编程混合使用，具备动态依赖调度器实现自动并行化，适用于 Python、R、Julia、Scala、Go、JavaScript 等多种语言。其核心优势在于跨平台部署能力、多 GPU 及分布式扩展性，同时提供图优化层提升执行效率与内存利用率，广泛用于工业级 AI 系统开发。
repos.summary_en: Apache MXNet is a deep learning framework optimized for efficiency and flexibility, supporting mixed symbolic and imperative programming with a dynamic dependency scheduler for automatic parallelization. It supports multiple languages including Python, R, Julia, Scala, Go, and JavaScript. MXNet excels in cross-platform deployment, multi-GPU and distributed scalability, and features graph optimization for fast, memory-efficient execution, making it ideal for production AI systems.

repos.description: Orchestrate multiple coding agents from desktop and mobile
repos.summary_zh: Paseo 是一个跨平台编程代理编排工具，支持通过手机、桌面端和 CLI 远程管理 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 等 AI 编码助手。核心特性包括本地自托管运行、多模型统一接口、语音控制、跨设备同步以及零追踪的隐私保护。用户可在任意终端启动任务，实现从构思到部署的无缝协作。
repos.summary_en: Paseo is a cross-platform orchestration tool for coding agents, enabling remote management of Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode via phone, desktop, or CLI. Key features include self-hosted local execution, unified multi-provider interface, voice control, device synchronization, and privacy-first design with no telemetry. It allows seamless task delegation and hands-off automation across environments.

repos.description: 🌈一个跨平台的划词翻译和OCR软件 | A cross-platform software for text translation and recognition.
repos.summary_zh: Pot 是一款跨平台划词翻译与 OCR 软件，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 及 Wayland 环境，集成 OpenAI、Google、DeepL 等 20+ 翻译接口，提供多接口并行翻译、语音合成、生词本导出等功能，具备插件系统和外部调用能力，界面简洁高效。
repos.summary_en: Pot is a cross-platform software for text translation and OCR, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux and Wayland. It integrates 20+ translation APIs including OpenAI, Google, and DeepL, offering parallel translation, speech synthesis, vocabulary export, plugin system, and external call functionality with a clean interface.

repos.description: React Native指南汇集了各类react-native学习资源、开源App和组件
repos.summary_zh: React Native学习指南是一个全面的中文资源库，汇集了React Native开发教程、开源APP案例、组件库、工具链及权威文档，覆盖从入门到原生模块开发的完整技术栈，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: The React Native Learning Guide is a comprehensive Chinese resource hub compiling tutorials, open-source apps, components, tools, and official documentation for React Native development, covering everything from beginner guides to native module integration for cross-platform mobile app creation.

repos.description: 收集&推荐优秀的 Apps/硬件/技巧/周边等
repos.summary_zh: Best App 是一个精选优质应用、硬件及生活技巧的推荐项目，涵盖 macOS、iOS、Android 等平台。聚焦付费与免费精品应用，提供详细功能介绍与横向测评，帮助用户高效选择提升效率与幸福感的工具。项目强调客观推荐，拒绝广告与捐赠，倡导有章可循的产品选择。
repos.summary_en: Best App is a curated collection of excellent apps, hardware, and life-enhancing tips across macOS, iOS, and Android. It features detailed reviews and comparisons of premium and free apps, helping users make informed choices for productivity and lifestyle improvement. The project maintains objectivity, avoids ads, and encourages community contributions via Star or Pull Request.

repos.description: 一个第三方音乐播放器、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载、远程控制
repos.summary_zh: AlgerMusicPlayer 是一款功能强大的第三方跨平台音乐播放器，支持网易云账号登录、本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载及远程控制。基于 Electron 和 Vue 开发，提供沉浸式歌词显示、EQ均衡器、多语言界面和明暗主题切换，支持全平台运行（桌面/Web/移动端），兼顾高品质音质与个性化体验。
repos.summary_en: AlgerMusicPlayer is a powerful third-party cross-platform music player supporting NetEase Cloud login, local services, desktop lyrics, music downloads, and remote control. Built with Electron and Vue, it offers immersive lyrics, EQ equalizer, multi-language UI, dark/light themes, and high-fidelity audio, running on Desktop, Web, and Mobile platforms with personalized features.

repos.description: This repository is outdated and new Boost Note app is available! We've launched a new Boost Note app which supports real-time collaborative writing. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App
repos.summary_zh: BoostNote-Legacy 是一款面向程序员的开源笔记应用，支持多平台（Mac、Windows、Linux）。该仓库已标记为过时，推荐使用支持实时协作的新版 BoostNote 应用，其基于 Electron、React + Redux 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端支持。
repos.summary_en: BoostNote-Legacy is an open-source note-taking app designed for programmers, supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. This repository is deprecated; users are advised to migrate to the new BoostNote app, which features real-time collaborative writing and is built with Electron, React + Redux.

repos.description: Bridge local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms (Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, WeChat Work). Chat with your AI dev assistant from anywhere — no public IP required for most platforms.
repos.summary_zh: CC-Connect 是一款将本地 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Codex）桥接到飞书、钉钉、Slack、Telegram、Discord、LINE、企业微信等即时通讯平台的中间件工具。用户无需公网 IP，即可通过消息平台随时随地与本地 AI 开发助手对话协作，实现远程编程辅助。核心亮点是跨平台消息桥接与零公网部署，极大提升了 AI 编程助手的可访问性和使用灵活性。
repos.summary_en: CC-Connect bridges local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms including Feishu, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, and WeChat Work. It enables users to chat with their local AI dev assistant from anywhere without requiring a public IP for most platforms. The core value lies in cross-platform message bridging and zero-public-IP deployment, significantly enhancing the accessibility and flexibility of AI coding assistants.

repos.description: Codex Dream Skin
repos.summary_zh: Codex Dream Skin 是一款针对 OpenAI Codex 桌面端的跨平台换肤工具。它通过本机回环 CDP 注入技术，在不修改官方安装包与代码签名的前提下，实现对侧栏、输入框等原生控件的主题化定制。支持一键换图与还原，兼顾个性化氛围感与系统安全性。
repos.summary_en: Codex Dream Skin is a cross-platform theming tool for the OpenAI Codex desktop app. Utilizing local loopback CDP injection, it customizes native UI elements like sidebars and input boxes without altering the official installation package or code signature. It supports one-click image swapping and restoration, balancing personalized aesthetics with system security.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: Electronic WeChat 是一款基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，专为 macOS 和 Linux 设计。它复刻了网页版微信的所有功能，包括消息撤回拦截、表情包支持、拖拽发送图片等，并优化了原生应用体验。项目已停止维护，但作为 Electron 桌面应用开发的优秀范例仍具参考价值。
repos.summary_en: Electronic WeChat is an Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, replicating all Web WeChat features including message recall blocking and sticker support. It offers native-like experience with optimizations like direct URL access and drag-and-drop file sharing. Though discontinued, it serves as an excellent reference for Electron desktop app development.

repos.description: :speech_balloon: A better WeChat on macOS and Linux. Built with Electron by Zhongyi Tong.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Electron 开发的跨平台微信客户端，支持 macOS 和 Linux，提供现代化界面和完整 Web 微信功能，包括消息撤回拦截、贴图支持、文件拖拽发送等。项目已停止维护，作为技术存档供学习参考。
repos.summary_en: An Electron-based cross-platform WeChat client for macOS and Linux, featuring modern UI, full Web WeChat functionality, message recall blocking, sticker support, and drag-and-drop file sharing. The project is archived and no longer actively maintained.

repos.description: A powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, which supports global settings, Interceptors, FormData, aborting and canceling a request, files uploading and downloading, requests timeout, custom adapters, etc.
repos.summary_zh: dio 是一个强大的 Dart 和 Flutter HTTP 客户端库，支持全局配置、拦截器、FormData、请求取消、文件上传下载、超时控制及自定义适配器。提供完整的 REST API 调用能力，适用于移动端和 Web 应用开发，具备高度可定制性和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: dio is a powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, supporting global settings, interceptors, FormData, request cancellation, file uploads/downloads, timeouts, and custom adapters. It offers full REST API capabilities with high customization and cross-platform compatibility for mobile and web apps.

repos.description: A practical Douyin downloader for both single-item and profile batch downloads, with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, and browser fallback support. 抖音批量下载工具，去水印，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐(原声)。
repos.summary_zh: 抖音批量下载工具，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐及主页作品去水印下载。具备进度显示、自动重试、SQLite去重、完整性校验及浏览器兜底抓取功能，并提供跨平台桌面端应用（支持抖音、TikTok、YouTube），实现多链接队列与账号内容同步。
repos.summary_en: A practical Douyin batch downloader supporting watermark-free downloads of videos, galleries, collections, and music. Features progress display, auto-retry, SQLite deduplication, integrity checks, and browser fallback. Includes a cross-platform desktop app for Douyin, TikTok, and YouTube with multi-link queuing and account sync.

repos.description: Essential UI blocks for building mobile web apps.
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design Mobile 是构建移动端 Web 应用的核心 UI 组件库，提供高性能、可定制的原子化组件，支持 CSS 变量主题定制与流畅动画，适用于快速开发跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design Mobile is a core UI component library for building mobile web apps, offering high-performance, customizable atomic components with CSS variable theming and smooth animations for cross-platform mobile development.

repos.description: 👩‍🚒 Good content deserves good paper.
repos.summary_zh: Kami 是一个面向 AI 智能体的文档设计系统，通过一套约束语言和九种模板，将 AI 生成的内容自动排版为可直接交付的 PDF 与落地页。支持中英日韩多语言，提供 Claude Code 插件、通用 Agent 技能包等多种集成方式，解决 AI 输出样式不一致的问题。
repos.summary_en: Kami is a document design system for AI agents: one constraint language, nine templates, producing shippable PDFs and landing pages. Supports English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Integrates via Claude Code plugin, generic agent skills, or Claude Desktop—ensuring consistent, production-ready output.

repos.description: Not Just A Notepad! (golang + mongodb) http://leanote.org
repos.summary_zh: Leanote 是一款功能强大的开源笔记应用，采用 Go 语言和 MongoDB 构建，提供富文本和 Markdown 编辑器，支持 Vim/Emacs 编辑模式、知识管理、协作分享及博客发布。它弥补了 Evernote 在代码高亮、实时渲染、跨平台支持等方面的不足，适合个人与团队知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Leanote is a powerful open-source note-taking app built with Go and MongoDB, featuring rich-text and Markdown editors, Vim/Emacs modes, knowledge management, collaboration, and blogging. It addresses Evernote's limitations in code syntax highlighting, real-time rendering, and cross-platform support, ideal for personal and team knowledge management.

repos.description: Command-line tool that allows you to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS, and macOS apps on the App Store, and download .ipa or macOS .pkg app packages.
repos.summary_zh: ipatool 是一款跨平台命令行工具，支持从 App Store 搜索并下载 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用的 IPA 包。提供认证、搜索、授权获取、版本管理等核心功能，适用于开发者自动化部署、企业级应用分发及批量下载场景。
repos.summary_en: ipatool is a cross-platform command-line tool for searching and downloading iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS app packages (IPA) from the App Store. It supports authentication, search, license acquisition, and version management, ideal for developer workflows, enterprise distribution, and batch app management.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一款免费无广告的追剧资源聚合指南，人工精选并每日自动检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等117个资源，完全开源，支持社区共同维护与贡献。
repos.summary_en: A free, ad-free curated guide for streaming resources with manual selection and daily automated validation. Covers online streaming, TV apps, cloud search, torrent/磁力 links, subtitles, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources—117 resources total, fully open-source and community-maintained.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费且无广告的追剧资源导航项目。它通过人工精选与每日自动化检测，收录了涵盖在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、TVBox配置及IPTV直播源等80余个高质量资源。项目采用社区共同维护模式，旨在为用户提供纯净、有效且持续更新的影视观看解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free resource guide for tracking dramas and movies. Combining manual curation with daily automated availability checks, it aggregates over 80 high-quality resources including online streaming, apps, cloud storage searches, magnet links, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources. Maintained by the community, it aims to provide a pure, reliable, and continuously updated viewing solution.

repos.description: [deprecated in favor of https://microsoft.github.io/react-native-windows/] React Native for macOS is an experimental fork for writing desktop apps using Cocoa
repos.summary_zh: React Native macOS 是一个实验性分支，允许使用 React Native 和 Cocoa 构建 macOS 桌面应用。该项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至微软官方支持的 React Native Windows 或利用 Catalyst 技术运行。
repos.summary_en: React Native for macOS was an experimental fork enabling desktop app development using React Native and Cocoa. The project is now deprecated and no longer maintained, with Microsoft's React Native Windows recommended as the successor.

repos.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
repos.summary_zh: Hermes Studio 是 Hermes Agent 的全功能本地控制平面，提供跨平台 AI 聊天、会话管理、定时任务与用量分析。支持 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等 8 大平台统一配置，内置文件浏览器、Web 终端、语音交互与编码代理运行器。以桌面应用、npm CLI 和 Docker 镜像三种形式分发，所有数据本地存储于 SQLite，确保隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Studio is a comprehensive local control plane for Hermes Agent, delivering multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics. It unifies configuration across 8 platforms including Telegram, Discord, and Slack, with built-in file browsing, web terminal, voice I/O, and coding agent runners. Distributed as a desktop app, npm CLI package, and Docker image, all data stays local via SQLite storage.

repos.description: :zap: Transfer files over wifi from your computer to your mobile device by scanning a QR code without leaving the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: qrcp 是一款通过扫描二维码实现电脑与移动设备间 Wi-Fi 文件传输的工具，无需离开终端即可完成操作。它通过生成包含随机路径 URL 的二维码，扫描后自动在移动端浏览器打开下载链接，支持单文件、多文件或文件夹传输，并提供压缩选项，兼容主流操作系统。
repos.summary_en: qrcp is a tool that enables Wi-Fi file transfer between computers and mobile devices by scanning a QR code, all from the terminal. It generates a QR code containing a URL with a random path; scanning it opens the download link in the mobile browser, supporting single/multiple files, folders, and optional compression. Compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.

repos.description: ✍️ A static blog writing client (一个静态博客写作客户端)
repos.summary_zh: Gridea 是一款跨平台静态博客写作客户端，支持 Markdown 编辑、多语言界面、主题定制及 Gitalk/DisqusJS 评论系统。用户可本地创作并一键发布至 GitHub Pages 等平台，集成 OneDrive/iCloud 实现多设备同步，适合个人知识管理与内容创作。
repos.summary_en: Gridea is a cross-platform static blog writing client that supports Markdown editing, multi-language interface, theme customization, and Gitalk/DisqusJS comment systems. It enables local content creation with one-click publishing to platforms like GitHub Pages, featuring OneDrive/iCloud sync for multi-device workflows, ideal for personal knowledge management and content creation.

repos.description: Featuring powerful AI capabilities and supporting various e-book formats, it makes reading smarter and more focused.
repos.summary_zh: Anx Reader 是一款专为书迷打造的智能电子书阅读器，集成强大 AI 功能，支持 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、FB2、TXT、PDF 等多种格式。提供 AI 摘要、翻译、思维导图生成、多端同步、自定义排版、语音朗读及阅读统计等深度功能，致力于提升阅读效率与沉浸体验。
repos.summary_en: Anx Reader is an AI-powered e-book reader designed for book lovers, supporting multiple formats like EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, TXT, and PDF. It features AI summaries, translation, mind mapping, cross-platform sync, customizable typography, TTS, and reading analytics to enhance focus and reading pleasure.

repos.description: 网易云音乐第三方
repos.summary_zh: ieaseMusic 是一款基于 Electron、React 和 MobX 构建的优雅网易云音乐第三方桌面客户端，支持跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）、高音质（FLAC）、键盘操作、桌面通知、Last.fm 听歌记录同步、多平台音源修复（如 QQ 音乐、虾米等）、社交分享及微信扫码登录，集成 Alfred 3 工作流，提供现代化 UI 与下载功能。
repos.summary_en: ieaseMusic is an elegant third-party Netease Music desktop app built with Electron, React, and MobX. It supports cross-platform use (macOS/Linux/Windows), high-quality FLAC audio, keyboard shortcuts, desktop notifications, Last.fm scrobbling, multi-source link fixing (e.g., QQ, Xiami), social sharing, WeChat login, and includes an Alfred 3 workflow for quick access.

repos.description: Open-source KVM software
repos.summary_zh: Input Leap 是一款开源 KVM 软件，模拟传统硬件 KVM 切换器的功能，允许用户通过单一键盘和鼠标控制多台计算机。支持跨系统无缝切换，具备剪贴板共享功能（Linux/Wayland 除外），强调跨平台兼容性（Windows/macOS/Linux/FreeBSD）与用户友好的可靠性设计。
repos.summary_en: Input Leap is an open-source KVM software that mimics hardware KVM switches by enabling a single keyboard and mouse to control multiple computers. It supports seamless screen switching, clipboard sharing (except on Linux/Wayland), and prioritizes cross-platform compatibility (Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD) with a focus on hassle-free reliability and open communication.

repos.description: 30 days of React Native demos
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是30天React Native实战教程，涵盖从基础组件到高级动画、手势识别、地图定位、生物识别等22个完整案例，包含iOS原生级交互效果，适合移动端开发学习者系统掌握React Native核心技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a 30-day React Native tutorial series featuring 22 complete demos, covering core components, animations, gestures, maps, biometric authentication, and more. It provides hands-on experience with iOS-level interactions for mobile development learners.

repos.description: p2p.kiwi 🥝, Cross-Platform screen 🖥️ sharing 📡 made simple ⚡.
repos.summary_zh: p2p.kiwi是一款跨平台P2P屏幕共享工具，支持Mac、Windows和Linux系统。无需注册账户，不依赖服务器基础设施，仅通过STUN/TURN及信令服务器完成初始连接交换。适合远程协作、技术支持与即时屏幕分享场景，实现高效安全的点对点数据传输。
repos.summary_en: p2p.kiwi is a cross-platform P2P screen sharing tool supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. No account registration required, operates without server infrastructure beyond STUN/TURN and signaling servers for initial connection setup. Ideal for remote collaboration, tech support, and instant screen sharing with secure peer-to-peer data transfer.

repos.description: Bananas🍌, Cross-Platform screen 🖥️ sharing 📡 made simple ⚡.
repos.summary_zh: Bananas 是一款跨平台屏幕共享工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，采用点对点连接技术，无需注册或服务器中转（仅需 STUN/TURN 和信令服务器完成初始连接）。主打隐私安全、简单易用，适合快速分享屏幕。
repos.summary_en: Bananas is a cross-platform screen sharing tool for Mac, Windows, and Linux, using peer-to-peer connections without requiring accounts or central servers (except for STUN/TURN and signaling servers). It emphasizes privacy, simplicity, and instant sharing.

repos.description: "Sigma File Manager" is a free, open-source, quickly evolving, modern file manager (explorer / browser) app for Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Sigma File Manager 是一款免费开源的现代文件管理器，专为 Windows 和 Linux 设计，支持快速文件浏览与操作。项目已进入 v2 稳定测试阶段，提供直观界面与高效功能，适用于日常文件管理需求。
repos.summary_en: Sigma File Manager is a free, open-source, modern file manager for Windows and Linux, offering fast file browsing and operations. Now in v2 beta, it features an intuitive interface and efficient tools for streamlined file management.

repos.description: Flutter Launch Timeline Demo
repos.summary_zh: 该应用是一个基于 Flutter 开发的交互式时间轴应用，展示从宇宙大爆炸到互联网诞生的历史事件。通过精美的动画和垂直滚动时间轴，用户可探索不同时代的关键事件，每个事件配有动态气泡和详细文章页面。核心技术包括 Flutter 框架、Flare 和 Nima 动画库，以及自定义 LeafRenderObjectWidget 实现高性能渲染。
repos.summary_en: This is an interactive vertical timeline app built with Flutter, showcasing historical events from the Big Bang to the Internet. It features animated event bubbles, detailed article pages, and smooth scrolling/zooming. Built using Flutter with Flare and Nima animation libraries, plus custom LeafRenderObjectWidget for high-performance rendering.

repos.description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
repos.summary_zh: PI-Desktop是一款本地优先的AI编程代理桌面应用，采用Electron + Rust架构。支持OpenAI、Anthropic及自定义模型，提供Agent/Plan/Goal三种协作模式，内置权限审查层与可扩展插件系统，实现跨平台独立编码工作空间。
repos.summary_en: PI-Desktop is a local-first AI coding agent desktop app built with Electron and Rust. It supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and custom models, offers Agent/Plan/Goal modes with permission controls and an extensible plugin system for cross-platform independent coding workspaces.

repos.description: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world
repos.summary_zh: DeepChat 是一个功能丰富的开源 AI 智能体平台，统一整合模型、工具和智能体，支持多 LLM 对话、MCP 工具调用和 ACP 智能体集成，提供强大的桌面端 AI 助手体验。
repos.summary_en: DeepChat is a powerful open-source AI agent platform that unifies models, tools, and agents, offering multi-LLM chat, MCP tool calling, and ACP agent integration for seamless desktop AI assistance.

repos.description: A Flutter UI Kit（一个 Flutter UI组件库），包含 ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, WaterMark, GradientCircularProgressIndicator...
repos.summary_zh: Flukit 是一个功能丰富的 Flutter UI 组件库，提供 ScaleView、Swiper、PullRefresh、WaterMark 等实用 Widget，涵盖手势交互、动画效果、进度指示器等场景，支持自定义渐变按钮、弹性滚动头部等高级功能，显著提升 Flutter 开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Flukit is a comprehensive Flutter UI kit offering essential widgets like ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, and WaterMark. It supports advanced features such as gesture interactions, gradient animations, elastic headers, and progress indicators, significantly enhancing Flutter app development efficiency.

repos.description: A git client based on the IntelliJ platform
repos.summary_zh: Rebased 是一款基于 IntelliJ 平台构建的开源 Git 客户端，旨在替代 JetBrains 官方未实现的独立 Git 工具愿景。它剥离了 IDE 中除 Git 集成外的所有插件，并优化了界面，提供轻量级、专注的版本控制体验。支持 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 多平台安装。
repos.summary_en: Rebased is an open-source Git client built on the IntelliJ platform, designed as a standalone alternative to JetBrains' discontinued Git tool initiative. It strips down the full IDE to only Git integration with UI enhancements, offering a lightweight, focused version control experience across Linux, Windows, and macOS.

repos.description: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款轻量级桌面应用，用于统一管理、同步和组织 AI 智能体技能，支持 15+ 主流开发工具（如 Cursor、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot 等）。通过中央仓库集中管理技能，支持从 Git 仓库、本地文件或市场导入，一键同步至目标工具，并提供场景分组、更新追踪和技能文档预览功能。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app that centralizes the management, sync, and organization of AI agent skills across 15+ coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot. It supports importing skills from Git repos, local folders, or the marketplace into a unified repository, enables one-click sync via symlinks/copies, and offers scenario grouping, update tracking, and in-app skill documentation preview.

repos.description: Postcat 是一个可扩展的 API 工具平台。集合基础的 API 管理和测试功能，并且可以通过插件简化你的 API 开发工作，让你可以更快更好地创建 API。An extensible API tool.
repos.summary_zh: Postcat 是一个开源、跨平台的 API 开发测试工具，支持 REST 和 WebSocket 协议，具备 API 管理、测试、Mock 及团队协作功能。通过插件系统实现功能扩展，提供多语言界面与自定义主题，适用于中小团队快速构建和验证 API。
repos.summary_en: Postcat is an open-source, cross-platform API development and testing tool supporting REST and WebSocket protocols. It offers API management, testing, Mock, team collaboration, and extensibility via plugins. With customizable themes and multi-language support, it enables efficient API creation and validation for small to medium teams.

repos.description: Python package for doing RPA
repos.summary_zh: RPA for Python 是一个强大的自动化工具包，提供简洁的 API 实现网页、桌面应用及 OCR 流程的自动化，支持跨平台运行，适用于重复性任务的高效处理，显著提升工作效率。
repos.summary_en: RPA for Python is a powerful automation toolkit offering a simple API to automate web, desktop, and OCR workflows across platforms, enabling efficient handling of repetitive tasks with minimal code.

repos.description: Multi-Platform Live Stream Automatic Recording Tool | 多平台直播流自动录制客户端 · 基于FFmpeg · 支持监控/定时/转码
repos.summary_zh: StreamCap 是一款基于 FFmpeg 的多平台直播流自动录制工具，支持 40+ 国内外主流直播平台（如抖音、B站、Twitch、TikTok），具备循环监控、定时录制、批量任务管理和自动转码功能，提供 Windows/macOS/Linux/Web 全平台支持，适用于内容存档与直播数据分析。
repos.summary_en: StreamCap is a multi-platform live stream recording tool powered by FFmpeg and StreamGet, supporting 40+ global platforms (e.g., Douyin, Bilibili, Twitch, TikTok). It features real-time monitoring, scheduled recording, batch processing, and automatic transcoding, with full support for Windows, macOS, Linux, and web deployment for content archiving and live data analysis.

repos.description: High-crafted UI libraries for AI agents: Border beam, Orbs, Metal, Gooey, Voice, Image, Avatar bots
repos.summary_zh: 专为 AI 智能体打造的高品质 React UI 特效库集合，包含 border-beam 动态边框光束、liquid-gooey 液态流体效果和 thinking-orbs 点阵加载动画。支持 React Native 与 SwiftUI 跨平台复用，采用 npm workspaces 多包管理，提供可视化演示站点与 CI 自动化发布流程。
repos.summary_en: High-quality React UI effect libraries tailored for AI agents, featuring animated border beams, liquid morph effects, and dotted orb loaders. Supports cross-platform React Native and SwiftUI ports. Built with npm workspaces for multi-package management, including hot-reload development and automated CI deployment.

repos.description: React Native入门指南
repos.summary_zh: React Native入门指南，系统讲解从环境搭建到组件开发的全流程，涵盖JSX语法、布局设计、UI组件使用及与原生代码集成，适合初学者快速掌握移动端跨平台开发技能。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive React Native tutorial covering fundamentals like JSX, layout design, UI components, and native module integration, designed for developers to master cross-platform mobile app development efficiently.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg是一款协作式多智能体AI编码工作空间，统一整合Claude Code、Codex、Grok等15+主流AI编程代理。提供桌面应用、自托管服务及Docker部署方案，支持跨平台使用。核心特性包括会话跨代理迁移、任务委托协作、统一对话界面，大幅降低多代理协作门槛。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace unifying 15+ AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Grok. Supports desktop, self-hosted, and Docker deployments across all platforms. Key features include session migration between agents, collaborative task delegation via @mentions, and a unified conversation interface.

repos.description: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprises form builder and analytics platform that allows users to create questionnaires, exams, polls, quizzes, and analyze data online.
repos.summary_zh: XIAOJUSURVEY 是一套企业级表单构建与数据分析平台，支持问卷、考试、投票等多样化调研场景。基于 Vue3 + NestJS 技术栈，提供 40+ 题型、100+ 模板，具备智能逻辑编排、AI 生成问卷、分题统计与交叉分析能力，支持品牌化定制与多端嵌入，适用于市场调研、客户满意度测评等复杂业务场景。
repos.summary_en: XIAOJUSURVEY is an enterprise-grade form builder and analytics platform enabling creation of questionnaires, exams, polls, and quizzes with online data analysis. Built on Vue3 + NestJS, it offers 40+ question types, 100+ templates, AI-powered survey generation, logic rules, cross-analysis, and brand customization for market research, customer feedback, and educational assessments.

repos.description: Record your screen, ship a demo. Free and open-source, GPU-accelerated, no watermarks, no subscriptions. Windows, macOS, Linux. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与演示制作工具，作为 Screen Studio 的开源替代方案。支持窗口/全屏录制、自动缩放、光标特效、摄像头画中画、本地 AI 字幕生成及 AI 编辑助手，适用于产品演示、教程视频和社交媒体内容创作，支持 macOS/Windows/Linux 跨平台使用。
repos.summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording and demo creation tool, positioned as an alternative to Screen Studio. It features window/full-screen recording, auto-zooms, cursor effects, webcam overlay, on-device AI captions, and an AI editing assistant. Ideal for product demos, tutorials, and social media content across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: Enhanced MCP server for interactive user feedback and command execution in AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and Desktop Application) with intelligent environment detection and cross-platform compatibility.
repos.summary_zh: MCP Feedback Enhanced 是一个增强型 MCP 服务器，专为 AI 辅助开发设计，支持 Web UI 和跨平台桌面应用双界面，具备智能环境检测与反馈驱动工作流，可显著降低平台成本并提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: MCP Feedback Enhanced is an enhanced MCP server designed for AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and cross-platform desktop app) with intelligent environment detection and feedback-driven workflows to reduce platform costs and boost development efficiency.

repos.description: Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Windows. (按住快捷键说话，松开即得润色后的文字)
repos.summary_zh: OpenLess 是一款开源的跨平台语音输入工具，支持 macOS 和 Windows。用户按住快捷键说话，松开后即可获得 AI 润色后的文本，并自动插入光标位置或复制到剪贴板。其核心亮点是 AI 提示模式，能将口语化表达转化为结构清晰、上下文丰富的提示词，适用于 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 工具，提升输入效率。
repos.summary_en: OpenLess is an open-source, cross-platform voice input app for macOS and Windows. Press a hotkey, speak naturally, and get AI-polished text inserted at your cursor or copied to clipboard. Its standout feature is AI-prompt mode, which transforms rambling speech into structured, context-rich prompts ready for use in ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.

repos.description: Collaborator is a place to create with agents.
repos.summary_zh: Collaborator 是一款面向智能体开发的跨平台桌面应用，将终端、代码编辑器和上下文文件整合在无限画布中，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。基于 Electron 40、React 19 和 Tailwind CSS 4 构建，集成 Monaco 编辑器、xterm.js 终端和 D3 可视化，实现本地优先、无账号的协作开发环境，消除上下文切换，提升智能体协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Collaborator is a cross-platform desktop environment for agentic development, unifying terminals, code editors, and context files on an infinite canvas. Built with Electron 40, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4, it integrates Monaco Editor, xterm.js terminal, and D3 visualization. Designed for local-first, account-free workflows, it eliminates context switching and enhances agent collaboration across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
repos.summary_zh: Cindy 是一款开源、开箱即用的跨平台 AI Agent 客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex 等多种模型编排。它可在本地运行，集成文件系统访问、浏览器自动化和 MCP 协议，实现跨设备的任务编排与自动化执行。
repos.summary_en: Cindy is an open-source, out-of-the-box AI agent client supporting Claude Code and Codex orchestration. It runs locally with file system access, browser automation, and MCP protocol integration for cross-device task orchestration and automated execution.

repos.description: Bridge Claude Code / Codex to IM platforms — chat with AI coding agents from Telegram, Discord, or Feishu/Lark.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-to-IM Skill 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，将 Claude Code / Codex 与 Telegram、Discord、飞书/Lark 或 QQ 等即时通讯平台桥接，实现通过 IM 聊天与 AI 编程代理交互。支持权限控制、流式响应预览、会话持久化，无需编码即可快速部署。
repos.summary_en: Claude-to-IM Skill is a lightweight CLI tool that bridges Claude Code/Codex with IM platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, and QQ. It enables chatting with AI coding agents directly from your chats, featuring permission control, streaming previews, session persistence, and zero-code setup.

repos.summary_zh: Litter 是 OpenAI Codex 的原生 iOS 与 Android 客户端，支持连接本地或远程服务器，在移动端运行智能体编程工作流。采用 Rust 核心通过 UniFFI 跨平台共享，Swift/Kotlin 仅处理 UI 与平台 API，实现高性能与代码复用。
repos.summary_en: Litter is a native iOS and Android client for OpenAI Codex, enabling users to connect to local or remote servers and run agentic coding workflows on mobile. It shares a single Rust core via UniFFI, keeping platform code (Swift/Kotlin) thin for high performance and code reuse.

repos.description: 一个 Linux.do 第三方客户端
repos.summary_zh: FluxDO 是一款基于 Flutter 框架开发的 Linux.do 社区第三方客户端，覆盖 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 全平台。它采用 Material Design 3 设计语言，集成了 Rust 编写的高性能 DOH（DNS over HTTPS）代理以保障网络安全与防污染，并提供完整的论坛交互、Markdown 编辑及实时消息推送功能。
repos.summary_en: FluxDO is a cross-platform third-party client for the Linux.do community, built with Flutter. It features Material Design 3 and integrates a Rust-based DOH (DNS over HTTPS) proxy for secure, pollution-free networking. The app offers a complete forum experience with Markdown editing, real-time notifications, and native performance across mobile and desktop systems.

repos.description: A tab bar that switches between scenes, written in JS for cross-platform support
repos.summary_zh: react-native-tab-navigator 是一个基于 JavaScript 的跨平台标签栏组件，专为 React Native 设计，支持 iOS 和 Android。它允许在多个场景间切换，提供自定义图标、徽章、标题等交互元素，兼容 React Native 0.16+，适用于构建原生级标签导航界面。
repos.summary_en: react-native-tab-navigator is a cross-platform tab bar component written in JavaScript for React Native, supporting iOS and Android. It enables switching between scenes with customizable icons, badges, and titles, compatible with React Native 0.16+. Ideal for building native-like tab navigation interfaces.

repos.summary_zh: litter 是一个原生 iOS 和 Android 客户端，专为 Codex 设计，支持跨平台连接 Mac 设备并通过 SSH 访问 Codex 会话。项目采用 Rust 编写核心模块，使用 UniFFI 实现移动端与 Rust 的桥接，集成音频处理（AEC）和网络发现功能（Bonjour/Tailscale），提供高对比度、无障碍友好的 UI 界面。
repos.summary_en: Litter is a native iOS and Android client for Codex, enabling cross-platform access to Mac-based Codex sessions via SSH. Built with Rust for core logic and UniFFI for mobile bridging, it includes audio processing (AEC), network discovery (Bonjour/Tailscale), and supports accessibility features like high contrast and large text modes.

repos.description: ChatMCP is an AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
repos.summary_zh: ChatMCP 是一款跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，完整实现 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，支持 MacOS、Windows、Linux、iOS、Android 和 Web 多端运行。提供本地存储、数据同步、LaTeX 渲染、Mermaid 图表生成、HTML 预览及多 LLM 模型接入等功能，适用于智能对话与工具集成场景。
repos.summary_en: ChatMCP is a cross-platform AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), supporting MacOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and Web. It offers local storage, data sync, LaTeX rendering, Mermaid diagram generation, HTML preview, and multi-LLM provider integration for intelligent conversations and tool workflows.

repos.description: Elegant Microsoft To-Do desktop app
repos.summary_zh: Ao 是一款优雅的开源 Microsoft To-Do 桌面应用，支持深色/黑色/琥珀色主题、紧凑模式、全局快捷键、列表导航及跨平台使用，覆盖 120 余国用户，提供高度可定制界面与自动夜间模式，通过 GitHub Sponsors 获得社区支持。
repos.summary_en: Ao is an elegant, unofficial, open-source Microsoft To-Do desktop app used globally, featuring dark themes, compact mode, global shortcuts, list navigation, scalable UI, and auto-night mode, with community-driven development and support via GitHub Sponsors.

repos.description: A web developer workflow used by WeChat team based on Gulp, with cross-platform supported and solutions prepared.
repos.summary_zh: Tencent tmt-workflow 是基于 Gulp 的前端自动化开发工作流工具，专为微信团队设计，支持跨平台（macOS & Windows）。提供 Less/Sass 编译、CSS 雪碧图、图片压缩、SVG 内联、JS 合并、LiveReload 实时刷新、FTP 部署等完整解决方案，集成 px2rem、WebP 适配等现代前端优化方案，现已迁移至 Feflow 项目。
repos.summary_en: Tencent's tmt-workflow is a Gulp-based frontend development workflow tool designed for the WeChat team, offering cross-platform support (macOS & Windows). It provides comprehensive automation features including Less/Sass compilation, CSS sprites, image compression, SVG inlining, JS bundling, LiveReload, and FTP deployment. Integrated solutions for px2rem, WebP, and MD5 reversion are included. The project has been migrated to Feflow.

repos.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；通过自写插件可支持其他线上音乐服务；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:
repos.summary_zh: VutronMusic 是一款高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持本地音乐、流媒体服务（如Navidrome、Jellyfin）、离线歌单及逐字歌词。具备桌面歌词、状态栏歌词、变调变速、自定义主题等功能，采用 Vue3 + TypeScript + Fastify 架构，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台。
repos.summary_en: VutronMusic is a high-end third-party NetEase Cloud Music player supporting local music, streaming services (Navidrome, Jellyfin), offline playlists, and karaoke-style lyrics. Features include desktop lyrics, system tray display, pitch/speed control, custom themes, and advanced audio effects. Built with Vue3, TypeScript, Fastify, and Electron for cross-platform support.

repos.description: DCloud开源项目集锦
repos.summary_zh: DCloud开源项目合集，涵盖uni-app、uni-app x、uniCloud、UTS等全栈开发框架的示例工程，提供uni-ai x全平台AI聊天套件及uVue语法测试项目，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用与云端一体化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: DCloud's open-source project collection featuring example projects for uni-app, uni-app x, uniCloud, UTS, and more, including the open-source cross-platform AI chat suite uni-ai-x and uVue syntax test project, enabling rapid development of mobile and cloud-integrated applications.

repos.description: Power Keys - 解放 Windows 和 macOS 使用效率
repos.summary_zh: Power Keys 是一款专为 Windows 和 macOS 设计的效率工具，通过精心设计的无冲突快捷键组合，显著提升系统操作效率。其核心价值在于统一跨平台快捷键逻辑，降低学习成本，适用于日常办公、开发及多任务处理场景。
repos.summary_en: Power Keys is an efficiency tool for Windows and macOS that boosts productivity through well-designed, non-conflicting keyboard shortcuts. It unifies cross-platform shortcut logic, reducing learning curves for developers and power users in daily workflows and multitasking.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents. Coming to Windows
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS GUI 工具，为 Mole CLI 提供可视化操作界面。它集成了磁盘清理、应用卸载、系统优化、磁盘分析及实时状态监控功能，并支持长期历史记录与本地 MCP 服务器，方便 AI 智能体通过自然语言直接操控系统维护任务，即将支持 Windows 平台。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS GUI for the Mole CLI engine. It bundles disk cleaning, app uninstallation, system optimization, disk analysis, and live status monitoring. Featuring long-range history and a local MCP server, it enables AI agents to autonomously diagnose and resolve system issues via natural language, with a Windows version in preview.

repos.description: Develop desktop apps with a web frontend or native UI in Go
repos.summary_zh: 用Go开发桌面应用，支持WebView网页前端或纯Go原生UI，混合使用。纯Go无cgo跨平台，类型化IPC，内置Flexbox/Grid布局、动画等UI工具包，自带完整打包分发能力，单二进制仅数MB，低内存CPU占用。
repos.summary_en: Build desktop apps in Go with web or native UI. Pure Go, no cgo, cross-platform. Typed IPC with generated TypeScript client. Built-in UI toolkit (flexbox/grid, animations). Complete bundling & distribution. Single binary, low memory/CPU footprint.

repos.description: :collision::collision::collision:【Flutter版】玩安卓，非常适合学习，代码不多、注释多。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Flutter 开发的玩安卓客户端应用，代码简洁、注释详尽，非常适合 Flutter 初学者学习。项目完整实现了登录注册、首页列表、搜索、侧边栏、WebView 加载、主题切换、状态管理等功能，涵盖常用 UI 组件和状态管理方案，并提供多平台截图与 APK 下载。
repos.summary_en: This is a WanAndroid client app built with Flutter, featuring clean code and extensive comments, ideal for Flutter beginners. It implements core features like login, homepage, search, sidebar, WebView, theme switching, and state management, covering essential UI components and state management patterns, with multi-platform screenshots and APK available.

repos.description: ✨ AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，致力于让个人收藏的 AI 提示词能够发挥最大价值。支持变量替换、Jinja 模板、AI 生成与调优、历史版本记录、云端备份等核心功能。
repos.summary_zh: AI Gist 是一款隐私优先的 AI 提示词管理工具，支持 Jinja 模板与变量动态替换，集成多种 AI 模型实现自动生成与调优提示词。所有数据本地存储，支持 WebDAV/iCloud 云端备份，跨 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 多平台运行，帮助用户高效收藏与管理个人提示词资产。
repos.summary_en: AI Gist is a privacy-first AI prompt management tool featuring Jinja template support and dynamic variable substitution. It integrates multiple AI models for auto-generating and optimizing prompts, with all data stored locally. Cloud backup via WebDAV/iCloud is supported. Cross-platform for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, it helps users efficiently collect and manage personal prompt assets.

repos.description: AI-powered desktop SQL client. Cross-platform. Built with Flutter.
repos.summary_zh: openhare 是一款基于 Flutter 开发的跨平台 AI 驱动桌面 SQL 客户端，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、SQLite 和 Oracle 等多种数据库。其核心亮点在于集成 AI 辅助功能，可智能生成、优化和理解 SQL 查询语句，显著提升开发者和 DBA 的工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Openhare is an AI-powered, cross-platform desktop SQL client built with Flutter, supporting multiple databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and Oracle. Its standout feature is integrated AI assistance for generating, optimizing, and interpreting SQL queries, enhancing productivity for developers and DBAs.

repos.description: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit, HackerNews, 雪球, BOSS直聘 etc.)
repos.summary_zh: opencli-skill 是一个 Claude Code 技能，通过复用 Chrome 登录态直接操控 B站、知乎、Twitter/X、YouTube 等 16 大平台，支持内容浏览、搜索与发布，无需 API Key，实现自然语言驱动的跨平台自动化交互。
repos.summary_en: opencli-skill is a Claude Code skill that enables natural language control over 16 major platforms (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube) by reusing your Chrome login sessions via opencli CLI—no API keys required—supporting reading, searching, and posting across social and content sites.

repos.description: Downloads : https://brahma-dev.github.io/synergy-stable-builds/
repos.summary_zh: Synergy 是一款开源的跨平台输入共享工具，允许用户通过一套键鼠无缝控制多台计算机。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，提供简洁的配置与编译流程，适用于多设备办公场景，强调自由使用与二次开发。
repos.summary_en: Synergy is an open-source, cross-platform tool that enables sharing a single mouse and keyboard across multiple computers. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, with straightforward configuration and build processes, ideal for multi-device productivity environments.

repos.description: RN 开源之初，写几个Mini-App
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是React Native早期实战项目集合，包含通讯录、LBS附近服务、豆瓣API搜索等Mini-App。涵盖文件系统Node.js服务端、通讯录管理、公告系统、地图定位及Webview集成，提供完整移动端开发范例，适合RN初学者学习全栈移动应用开发。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains early React Native practical projects including address book, LBS nearby services, and Douban API search apps. It covers Node.js file-based backend, contact management, announcements, map positioning, and Webview integration, serving as a comprehensive full-stack mobile development tutorial for RN beginners.

repos.description: Open-source cross-platform software KVM for sharing keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux on trusted LANs.
repos.summary_zh: MyKVM 是一款开源的跨平台软件 KVM 解决方案，允许用户通过局域网在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 设备间无缝共享键盘、鼠标和剪贴板。它利用 QUIC/TLS 加密传输输入与剪贴板数据，支持自动发现与多显示器布局，旨在替代传统硬件 KVM 切换器，为多机工作者提供零线缆的流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: MyKVM is an open-source, cross-platform software KVM that enables seamless sharing of keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices over a trusted LAN. Utilizing encrypted QUIC/TLS for input and clipboard data transfer, it features automatic peer discovery and multi-monitor layout support, aiming to replace traditional hardware KVM switches with a zero-cable experience for multi-machine workflows.

repos.description: a sudoku game written in React Native
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个使用 React Native 开发的数独游戏应用，具备动画效果、编辑模式、游戏进度保存及在线排行榜功能。开发者曾创下 3分43秒的解题记录，并计划扩展多难度等级、国际化支持和云端数据存储。
repos.summary_en: A React Native-based Sudoku game featuring animations, editing mode, game resume, and online leaderboards. The developer holds a personal record of 3:43 and plans to add multiple difficulty levels, i18n support, and cloud-based score storage.

repos.description: HiApp written in react-native.
repos.summary_zh: HiApp 是一款基于 React Native 开发的跨平台移动应用，支持 iOS 和 Android 平台。项目提供完整的开发环境配置指南，包含依赖安装、打包器启动及真机运行方案，适合学习 React Native 开发实践。
repos.summary_en: HiApp is a cross-platform mobile application built with React Native, supporting both iOS and Android. It includes setup instructions for dependency installation, packager startup, and device deployment, serving as a practical reference for React Native development.

repos.description: :zap: Sync all of your VSCode settings across multiple devices, supports any VSCode variant.
repos.summary_zh: VSCode Syncing 是一款强大的 VSCode 扩展，支持跨设备同步用户设置、键位绑定、扩展、语言包和代码片段至 GitHub Gist。支持增量同步、自动安装扩展、代理配置，并兼容 VSCodium、Cursor 等 VSCode 衍生版本。
repos.summary_en: VSCode Syncing is a powerful extension that synchronizes all VSCode settings—including user settings, keybindings, extensions, snippets, and locales—across multiple devices via GitHub Gist. It supports incremental sync, automatic extension management, proxy configuration, and works with any VSCode variant like VSCodium and Cursor.

repos.description: Independent iOS client for Lody — native chat, sessions, and coding-agent collaboration on iPhone
repos.summary_zh: 独立开源 iOS 客户端，为 Lody AI 协作平台打造。采用 React Native + Swift 6.0 混合架构，结合 CRDT 数据同步，支持无限聊天、流式文本渲染、代码 Diff 高亮与文件树导航，严格遵循 Apple HIG，提供安全的本地会话与远程服务桥接体验。
repos.summary_en: Independent open-source iOS client for Lody AI platform. Hybrid React Native + Swift 6.0 architecture with CRDT sync (Loro/Flock). Features infinite chat, streaming rendering, code diff highlighting, and file tree. Strictly follows Apple HIG for authentic native experience bridging local sessions and remote services.

repos.description: Pi — A cross-platform AI coding agent, bringing the Claude Code experience to your desktop. No environment setup, no terminal commands. Download and start coding right away.
repos.summary_zh: Pi Agent 是一款跨平台 AI 编码代理桌面应用，将 Claude Code 能力封装为免配置的一体化安装包。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，无需终端命令即可直接与 AI 助手协作编程。提供会话管理、模型配置、代码预览和自动更新等功能。
repos.summary_en: Pi Agent is a cross-platform AI coding agent desktop app that packages Claude Code capabilities into a standalone, zero-config application. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it enables seamless AI-assisted development without terminal commands. Features include session management, model configuration, code preview, and automatic updates.

repos.description: Versatile downloader for audio, video, podcasts, PDFs and more. Available as CLI and Docker | 多功能下载工具，支持音视频、播客、PDF等，提供 CLI 和 Docker 两种方式
repos.summary_zh: vget 是一款多功能下载工具，支持从音视频、播客、社交媒体（如小红书、Twitter）及WebDAV等资源下载内容，提供 CLI 和 Docker 部署方式，具备多语言支持和交互式配置向导，适用于跨平台自动化下载场景。
repos.summary_en: vget is a versatile downloader supporting audio, video, podcasts, PDFs, and social media content from platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter. It offers CLI and Docker deployment, multi-language support, and interactive configuration, ideal for cross-platform automated downloads.

repos.description: Agent-Native Terminal
repos.summary_zh: Termany 是一款 Agent-Native 终端，采用本地优先、云端就绪的架构。通过统一的 React 与 xterm.js 界面，支持 Web、桌面（Tauri）及未来云端部署。核心亮点在于无缝集成 Claude、Codex 等十余种主流 AI 编码代理，支持分屏多任务、文件树内嵌编辑与预览，并提供详细的 AI 使用成本与 Token 消耗分析面板。
repos.summary_en: Termany is an agent-native terminal with a local-first, cloud-ready architecture. It unifies Web, desktop (Tauri), and future cloud deployments under a single React and xterm.js UI. Key features include seamless integration of over a dozen AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, etc.), split-pane multitasking, inline file editing/preview, and a detailed dashboard for tracking AI usage costs and token consumption.

repos.description: Persistent, provider-neutral memory for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and MCP coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: PAXM 是一款专为 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code 等）设计的持久化、跨厂商记忆系统。它通过本地 SQLite 存储项目决策、架构规范与上下文，实现不同会话和不同代理间的知识无缝流转，解决每次新会话需重复解释项目背景的问题，且支持灵活切换 Zep、Mem0 等外部记忆存储提供商。
repos.summary_en: PAXM is a persistent, provider-neutral memory system designed for AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code. It stores project decisions, conventions, and context locally via SQLite, enabling seamless knowledge transfer across different sessions and agents. It eliminates the need to re-explain project backgrounds and supports flexible switching between storage backends like Zep and Mem0.

repos.description: 使用任何设备(浏览器)作为mac的副屏(随航) 将Android平板用作Mac的第二台显示器 还能在Win和Linux镜像屏幕
repos.summary_zh: 咩Display 是一款跨平台屏幕镜像工具，支持将任意带浏览器的设备（如 Android 平板）作为 Mac 的副屏，实现类似 Apple 随航的功能。基于 ffmpeg 实时转码，支持 mjpg、vp8、h264、hevc 多种编码，延迟低至 100ms（mjpg 模式），适用于 Windows/Linux 屏幕镜像。内置自动旋转、全屏切换，支持通过 ADB 实现 Android 有线连接，适合多屏办公与移动场景。
repos.summary_en: meDisplay is a cross-platform screen mirroring tool that turns any browser-equipped device (e.g., Android tablet) into a secondary display for Mac, mimicking Apple's Sidecar. Built with real-time ffmpeg transcoding, it supports mjpg, vp8, h264, and hevc encoding with ultra-low latency (as low as 100ms in mjpg mode). Also supports Windows/Linux X11 mirroring, auto-rotation, fullscreen toggle, and ADB-based Android wired connection for seamless multi-screen workflows.

repos.description: Douban Search App Based on React Native
repos.summary_zh: React-Dou 是基于 React Native 和豆瓣开放 API 开发的跨平台搜索应用，支持图书、音乐、电影三大类内容的搜索、列表展示与详情查看，具备完整的移动端交互体验，适用于快速构建豆瓣生态相关的数据检索工具。
repos.summary_en: React-Dou is a cross-platform search app built with React Native and Douban Open API, supporting search, listing, and detail views for books, music, and movies. It delivers a complete mobile experience for accessing Douban's content ecosystem.

repos.description: 让 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI Agent 成为你的跨平台电脑维修助手：64 个按需加载的 Playbook，覆盖诊断、清理、性能、网络与安全维护——C 盘爆满、电脑卡顿、流氓软件、应用迁移、数据恢复都能直接问；先取证、再计划，确认后修改。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个面向AI Agent的跨平台电脑维修Skill，提供64个按需加载的Playbook，覆盖Windows/macOS/Linux的诊断、清理、性能优化、网络与安全维护。采用
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform computer repair Skill for AI Agents, featuring 64 on-demand Playbooks covering Windows, macOS, and Linux diagnostics, cleanup, performance optimization, and security maintenance. Follows an evidence-first, plan-confirm-modify workflow for natural language-based PC troubleshooting.

repos.description: Any Agent × Any Provider × Anywhere. Connect Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex to Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat — with any LLM provider.
repos.summary_zh: GolemBot 是一个革命性工具，允许将 Cursor、Claude Code、OpenCode 或 Codex 等任意 AI 编程代理与任何 LLM 提供商集成，并部署到即时通讯（IM）、HTTP 接口或自有产品中。它通过单一配置实现跨平台运行，无需修改代码或依赖特定 AI 框架，支持 13,000+ OpenClaw 社区技能，极大扩展了 AI 代理的应用场景。
repos.summary_en: GolemBot enables running any coding agent (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) with any LLM provider and deploying it to IM platforms, HTTP endpoints, or custom products. It requires zero code changes, supports 13,000+ OpenClaw community skills, and integrates seamlessly via configuration—no AI framework dependency.

repos.description: 📚《Flutter 入门指南》
repos.summary_zh: 《Flutter 入门指南》是一本系统介绍 Flutter 跨平台开发框架的电子书，涵盖 Dart 语言、Skia 图形引擎及 Material Design UI 开发。适合有 JavaScript 基础的前端开发者快速掌握移动端、Web 和桌面端应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: 《Flutter 入门指南》is a comprehensive guide to Flutter, covering Dart language, Skia graphics engine, and Material Design UI development for cross-platform apps (mobile, web, desktop). Ideal for frontend developers with JavaScript background.

repos.description: ByeType 是一个 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频（使用自己的APIKEY），编辑 Markdown 文件即可自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略，人名、术语、口水词、数字格式一次转录到位，减少二次修改。支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS。
repos.summary_zh: ByeType 是一款基于 Markdown 提示词的 AI 语音输入工具，支持多模态大模型直接处理原始音频，实现专有词汇、术语、人名及数字格式的一次性精准转录，内置 AI 图像文字提取功能，可智能修复断行与还原代码结构，支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 平台，用户自备 API Key，数据直连服务商，安全高效。
repos.summary_en: ByeType is an AI-powered voice input tool driven by Markdown prompts, using multimodal LLMs to process raw audio directly for accurate transcription of names, jargon, and formatting in one pass. It includes AI-based text extraction from images, intelligently restoring broken lines and code structure. Supports macOS, Windows, and iOS with user-provided API keys for secure, direct cloud processing.

repos.description: Agent Skills for theming AI desktop apps: reference image → reversible Codex/WorkBuddy skin → verify, repair, publish. | 给 AI 桌面应用换肤的 Agent Skills：参考图 → 可逆皮肤 → 验证、修复、发布。
repos.summary_zh: CodeDrobe Skills 是一个开源的 AI 桌面应用主题生成与管理系统，专为 OpenAI Codex 和腾讯 WorkBuddy 等基于 Chromium/Electron 的 AI 桌面端提供可逆的主题定制方案。它通过 AI 技能（Skill）驱动，支持 DOM 快照分析、语义化主题生成与跨平台应用，极大简化了 AI 桌面环境的个性化与视觉管理。
repos.summary_en: CodeDrobe Skills is an open-source AI-driven theming engine for Chromium/Electron-based AI desktop apps like OpenAI Codex and Tencent WorkBuddy. It provides a reversible theme customization workflow utilizing DOM snapshot analysis and semantic generation. Managed via installable Agent Skills, it simplifies visual personalization and cross-platform theme deployment for AI desktop environments.

repos.description: A cross-platform skills manager for AI IDEs. Search marketplace, download locally, and install to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and more with one click.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款跨平台 AI IDE 技能管理工具，支持聚合搜索 Claude、Cursor、Windsurf 等10+主流AI开发环境的技能插件，一键下载至本地统一仓库并通过安全符号链接快速安装，提供版本控制、批量部署和自定义IDE支持，显著提升AI编程助手的功能扩展效率。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a cross-platform AI IDE skills management tool that aggregates search across major marketplaces (Claude Plugins, SkillsLLM, etc.), downloads skills to a unified local repository, and enables one-click installation into 10+ supported AI IDEs via secure symlinks. It features version control, bulk deployment, and custom IDE support for enhanced AI programming assistant capabilities.

repos.description: 一个将本地markdown在尽可能保持格式的情况下复制到公众号、知乎、飞书、X等平台的浏览器插件
repos.summary_zh: Markdown Paste Helper 是一款浏览器插件，可将本地 Markdown 内容一键粘贴至知乎、微信公众号、飞书、X Articles 等主流平台，自动转换为适配的富文本格式。支持预处理语法（如 GitHub alerts、任务列表）、自定义公众号主题色与代码高亮，并提供一键分发功能，实现‘一次编写，多端发布’的高效内容创作体验。
repos.summary_en: Markdown Paste Helper is a browser extension that enables one-click pasting of Markdown content into major platforms like Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, Feishu, and X Articles, automatically converting it to platform-specific rich text formats. It supports preprocessing syntax (e.g., GitHub alerts, task lists), custom WeChat themes with code highlighting, and offers batch distribution across logged-in platforms for efficient multi-platform publishing.

repos.description: singleFile + gh pages + deepseek api + notion db + tg bot = web clipper and notify
repos.summary_zh: Web Clipper Backend 是一个网页剪藏服务，支持将网页通过 SingleFile 插件保存至 GitHub Pages，利用 DeepSeek API 自动生成摘要与标签，并同步至 Notion 数据库，同时通过 Telegram Bot 推送通知，实现全自动化内容归档与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Web Clipper Backend is an automated web clipping service that saves web pages via SingleFile to GitHub Pages, uses DeepSeek API for AI-generated summaries and tags, syncs data to Notion database, and sends notifications via Telegram Bot, enabling seamless content archiving and knowledge management.

repos.description: 微信输入法（WeType）跨设备剪贴板的独立 Rust 客户端
repos.summary_zh: 微信输入法跨设备剪贴板的独立 Rust SDK，通过协议逆向实现文本、图片及文件的多设备同步。提供 CLI 工具 wxc，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows，基于局域网 TLS 直连传输，适合自动化脚本与跨设备数据流转场景。
repos.summary_en: An independent Rust SDK for WeType cross-device clipboard, enabling text, image, and file synchronization via protocol reverse engineering. Provides CLI wxc with multi-platform support and LAN TLS direct transfer, suitable for automation scripts and cross-device data workflows.

repos.description: 一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记、本地知识库、AI 智能助手、向量语义检索 。
repos.summary_zh: OpenNote 是一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记管理、本地知识库构建、AI 智能助手及向量语义检索。具备长期记忆与自我进化能力，通过 MCP 协议与 AI 大模型深度集成，实现知识的高效组织与智能问答，适合个人知识管理与 AI 增强型笔记场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenNote is a cross-platform intelligent note-taking Agent application that supports multi-format note management, local knowledge base building, AI-powered assistance, and vector semantic search. With long-term memory and self-evolving capabilities, it integrates deeply with AI large language models via the MCP protocol, enabling efficient knowledge organization and intelligent Q&A for personal knowledge management and AI-enhanced note-taking scenarios.

repos.description: Cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio (Wails v2 + Go) http://tui.studio
repos.summary_zh: TUIStudio Desktop 是基于 Wails v2（Go + WebView）构建的跨平台桌面应用，为 TUIStudio 提供原生 GUI 支持。支持 macOS (.dmg)、Windows (.exe) 和 Linux (.deb) 多平台发布，体积小巧（约8MB），通过 Go 与前端 Vite 热重载集成实现高效开发流程，适用于 TUI 界面可视化设计场景。
repos.summary_en: TUIStudio Desktop is a cross-platform desktop wrapper for TUIStudio, built with Wails v2 (Go + WebView). It packages as lightweight installers: .dmg (~8 MB), NSIS .exe, and .deb. Features hot-reload dev workflow via Vite and Go IPC bridge, enabling native file dialogs and seamless integration for TUI design tools.

repos.description: Turn an approved product design, PRD, prototype, design system, or architecture brief into an AI-governed, deployable full-stack project with a pnpm monorepo, requirement traceability, canonical multi-agent rules, mandatory AI review, executable quality gates, CI, container deployment assets, and handoff evidence.
repos.summary_zh: 面向VibeCoding的Codex工程Skill，将产品设计与架构规范转化为可部署的全栈项目。采用pnpm monorepo架构，支持多Agent协同规则、AI审查、质量门禁与CI/CD流水线，Routine模式高效处理日常修复，Init模式负责标准化初始化。
repos.summary_en: A Codex engineering skill for VibeCoding that transforms product designs into deployable full-stack projects using pnpm monorepo. Supports multi-agent rules, AI review, quality gates, and CI/CD pipelines, with Routine mode for efficient daily fixes and Init mode for standardized project setup.

repos.description: A Flask-based tool that types or copies text from mobile devices directly to Windows computers.
repos.summary_zh: EasyType 是一款基于 Flask 的跨平台输入工具，支持手机实时输入内容并直接推送到 Windows 剪贴板或模拟键盘输入，具备低延迟同步、移动端优化界面和多种快捷键支持，适用于远程办公与高效输入场景。
repos.summary_en: EasyType is a Flask-based tool enabling real-time text input from mobile devices to Windows via clipboard or direct keyboard simulation, featuring low-latency sync, mobile-optimized UI, and shortcut support for remote typing and clipboard sharing.

repos.description: 利用reactnative技术，开发，生成app
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 React Native 开发的移动端应用 demo，参考淘宝手机端 UI 设计，实现了包含首页、微淘、社区、购物车、个人中心等模块的 TabBar 界面。支持图标切换、角标提醒等功能，展示了 React Native 在跨平台 App 开发中的高效性和前端开发者上手友好的特点。
repos.summary_en: This project is a React Native-based mobile app demo, inspired by Taobao's mobile interface. It features a TabBar with modules like Home, Weitao, Community, Cart, and Profile, supporting icon switching and badge notifications. It demonstrates React Native's efficiency in cross-platform development and ease of use for frontend developers.
